history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity Empty Return Pre Advise details.
features: This feature allows the user to generate Pre Advice FCL file for Empty Return PR/Containers.
Selected PR container should not be in Prepared, Cancelled or Freeze status.

events.description: Generates the Pre Advice FCL file for the selected Empty Return PR/containers.
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more bookings using the check boxes, clicks the Menu icon near Depot Activity and clicks Empty Return Pre Advise.
